title: Te Amuamu i Rongohia i Runga Ake i te Haruru
intro: Ka rongo koe i tētahi reo e ara ake ana i tētahi hapori kua noho hei tikanga noa te tukino. Kāore he whakaaturanga mana e whakautu ana i te amuamu; engari, ka tae atu he karanga tika ki a Allah, ā, ka pā te whakautu ki te ngākau o te karakia tonu. Nā wai i amuamu, he aha te pātai i whai ake, ā, he aha te pono i whakaūngia?
clues: I pōuri ahau i te tukino a te hunga i tōku taha.
I whakapuakina e au taua amuamu ki a Allah i roto i tētahi amuamu whaiaro.
I whakarongo a Allah ki te amuamu, ā, ka whakautu mai ia ki te wero mō taku whakapono.
I pātai te whakautu, me pēhea rā ahau e kore ai e whakapono ki a Allah, te Kotahi, te Runga Rawa.
Kātahi ahau ka pātai he aha a Allah me manaaki ai i tētahi iwi kāore e whakapono ana.
Ko Uzair ahau, e whakahuatia ana i roto i te Surah Az-Zukhruf, ko te tangata i rangona e Allah tāna amuamu.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Uzair
Te hoa i rere i runga i te waipuke nui
Te pononga i haere i runga i te wai
Ko te tangata moe e tiakina ana i roto i te ana
Te pononga nāna i kawe ngā kōhatu ki te awa

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te amuamu ki a Allah mō te tukinotanga o te iwi
Te hikoi i runga i te wai i te wā o te tupuhi
Te kawe i ngā kōhatu ki te awa kāore he wai
Te rere i roto i te waipuke nui i runga i te Āraka
Te whiwhinga i te kī ki tētahi taonga nui whakaharahara
trial.answer: Te amuamu ki a Allah mō te tukinotanga o te iwi

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He amuamu tika ki a Allah
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He oumu i whakamataohia, i rangimārietia
He āka e mānu ana i runga i ngā wai waipuke
He ika e horomia ana te pononga
location.answer: He amuamu tika ki a Allah

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakarongo a Allah ki te amuamu, ā, i whakaū i te Kotahitanga o te Atua me te Ariki Nui.
Te hikoi haumaru i runga i te wai i te wā o te tupuhi
Te whiti haumaru i te waipuke nui i runga i te Āraka
Te tirohanga anō i roto i te whare rangatira o te whakapehapeha
Te whiwhi mana mai i te Rawhiti ki te Hauāuru
outcome.answer: I whakarongo a Allah ki te amuamu, ā, i whakaū i te Kotahitanga o te Atua me te Ariki Nui.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
